summary: Mama calls: when is the family coming to Sylhet, and what will they do?

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.en: Rafi, when will you all come to Sylhet?

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.en: Great! How many days will you stay?

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.en: What will you see in Sylhet?

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.bn: আমরা শহর দেখব, আর গ্রাম দেখব।
lines.tr: amra shohor dekhbo, ar gram dekhbo.
lines.en: We'll see the city, and we'll see a village.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.bn: তোমার মামি তোমাদের জন্য পিঠা তৈরি করবে।
lines.tr: tomar mami tomader jonno pitha toiri korbe.
lines.en: Your aunt will make pitha for you.

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.en: Really? I'll eat lots of pitha!

lines.speaker: Rafi
lines.bn: আপু খুব ব্যস্ত। কিন্তু ও আসবে, ইনশাআল্লাহ।
lines.tr: apu khub byasto. kintu o ashbe, inshaallah.
lines.en: Apu is very busy. But she'll come, God willing.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.en: OK. Then see you on Friday!

questions.question: When will they go to Sylhet?
questions.why: আগামী শুক্রবার = next Friday. ইনশাআল্লাহ ('God willing') is often said about plans.

questions.question: How many days will they stay?

questionBn.en: How many days will they stay?

questions.why: থাকব = we will stay; তিন দিন = three days.

questions.question: What will Mami make?
questions.why: পিঠা are rice cakes; তৈরি করবে = will make.

questions.question: What does Rafi say about Nadia?
options: She's very busy, but she'll come
questions.why: ব্যস্ত = busy; ও আসবে = she will come.
